title: The Buddy Vase / Glass cleaner
description:
Simple to use and practical; The Original Buddy is a magnetic scrubby tool that can reach inside small openings and odd shapes. Use Buddy to scrub out glass, baby bottles, coffee pots, fish bowls, small aquariums, wine decanters, antiques, glass art, vases and MORE!

For tough build-up Buddy can be used with any safe cleaner. Try using ordinary rubbing alcohol, detergent or nail polish remover. Make sure that any liquid cleaner you decide to use won’t harm fish or plants, and remember to rinse well.
